trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[pf:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (o:Owner)-[owns:Owns]->(t), (p)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(pd:Document), (t)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(td:Document), (c)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(cd:Document), (o)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(od:Document) WHERE pf.tenure = 'latest' RETURN c.state_name AS col1, p.olympic_gold_medals AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.college AS col4, owns.since_year AS col5, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team, o.name AS name_manager, c.city_name AS name_city
